text: Leo returned to the plaza carrying the groceries. The bag was heavy, but the nervousness in his chest felt even heavier.

speaker: Mira
text: Leo! You're back. How was the market?

speaker: Mira
text: You look exhausted, but you still did it.

speaker: Mira
text: It's alright. Sometimes it's really challenging when everyone at the market is in a rush.

speaker: Mira
text: Even if you made mistakes, you came back to set things right.

speaker: Mira
text: That's what's important, Leo. It doesn't have to be perfect right away. What matters is that you're trying to communicate.
For the first time, he was able to face the village all on his own.
